name: hcg-harness-marketplace
description: HCG portable development harness — Claude Code plugin marketplace. Repo-level tooling (hook + bootstrap-engine + skill-script unit tests); the plugins live in hcg-core/ (default) and hcg-harness/ (legacy).

scripts.test: node --test hcg-harness/hooks/*.test.mjs hcg-harness/scripts/*.test.mjs hcg-harness/skills/*/scripts/*.test.mjs hcg-core/hooks/*.test.mjs hcg-core/scripts/*.test.mjs
